rev.t: Milano Ice Cream Parlour in Indiranagar is a very good place to visit. The ice cream has nice flavours and tastes really good. It is a pleasant spot to stop by and enjoy a sweet treat with friends or family. Overall, a simple but very enjoyable experience.
